name: Frederick I of Denmark

checks.lead: Frederick I (Danish and Norwegian: Frederik; German: Friedrich; 7 October 1471 – 10 April 1533) was King of Denmark and Norway from 1523 and 1524, respectively, until his death in 1533, and earlier co-Duke of Schleswig and Holstein.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
